newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Lagos faces fuel crunch on tanker drivers dispute.
newsitem.headline: Lagos faces fuel crunch on tanker drivers dispute.

text.p: Long queues of vehicles formed at petrol stations in Nigeria's comercial capital Lagos as the city faced another of its perennial fuel shortages.
There was no immediate explanation for the latest problem but industry sources this week gave a warning of an imminent disruption in fuel distribution in the runup to Easter.
They cited a dispute between the Pretroleum Tanker Drivers' Association and the National Association of Road Transport Owners over conditions.
An industry weekly, Freight Monitor, predicted in its latest edition that Nigeria's fifth fuel supply rumpus this year could be the most serious if the dispute was not resolved.
There was no immediate comment from either union. The situation in other parts of the country was not clear.
